tune module

tune.get_baseline(val_data)[source]

Extracts baseline physical observables from the validation dataset.

Parameters:

val_data (tf.data.Dataset) -- The validation dataset containing batches of (spins, betas_norm) tensors.

Returns:

A tuple containing:

  • observables (dict): A dictionary mapping unique beta values to their corresponding true 'M' (magnetization) and 'E' (energy) values.

  • samples_per_beta (int): The number of lattice samples per unique beta.

Return type:

tuple

tune.objective(trial, base_config, train_data, val_data, ising_obs, samples_per_beta)[source]

The Optuna objective function for tuning the CVAE model.

This function manages a complete training lifecycle for a single trial: it sets up the hyperparameters, compiles the model, trains it, and evaluates its generative capability according to a physics loss function:

\[\text{error} = \sum_{\beta} \left( \frac{|M_{true} - M_{gen}|}{|M_{true}|} + \frac{|E_{true} - E_{gen}|}{|E_{true}|} \right)\]
Parameters:

  • trial (optuna.trial.Trial) -- The current Optuna trial object.

  • base_config (dict) -- The base configuration dictionary containing standard hyperparameters, training parameters, and scheduler settings.

  • train_data (tf.data.Dataset) -- The dataset used for training.

  • val_data (tf.data.Dataset) -- The dataset used for validation.

  • ising_obs (dict) -- Baseline physical observables computed from get_baseline.

  • samples_per_beta (int) -- The number of samples to generate per beta for evaluation.

Returns:

The total accumulated physical error (relative deviation from the baseline).

Return type:

float

tune.suggestions(trial, search_space_dict)[source]

Dynamically samples hyperparameters using Optuna based on a configuration.

Parameters:

  • trial (optuna.trial.Trial) -- The current Optuna trial object.

  • search_space_dict (dict) -- A dictionary defining the hyperparameter search space. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.

Returns:

A dictionary of sampled hyperparameter values for the current trial.

Return type:

dict
